Numotion
does not provide continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, sleep trackers, or remote patient monitoring
. Instead,
Numotion
is a leading U.S. provider of Complex Rehab Technology (CRT), customized power and manual wheelchairs, adaptive seating, and medical supplies for individuals with mobility disabilities.
Understanding the Terms
Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM):
A wearable sensor (such as Abbott FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom) that tracks interstitial glucose levels in real-time.
